title: workforce-cc install profile
description: Schema for profiles/<name>.json — declares which skills, agent packs, and hooks an install profile activates.

agent_packs.description: Subdirectories of agents/ to copy into ~/.claude/agents/. Empty array = install no agents.

hooks.description: Names of hook scripts to enable via hooks/dispatcher.sh. Empty / missing = no hooks.

harnesses.description: Which AI-coding-agent harnesses to write adapter files for. Default when missing: ['claude'] — preserves legacy install behavior. install.sh --harnesses overrides this list.
